lede: The web spent Thursday remembering Margaret Hamilton, the engineer who led software development for the Apollo program, dead at 90. Her passing was the one story the feeds shared, surfacing on Hacker News, Lemmy and Mastodon inside the same window. Otherwise the day stayed quiet. Counter-Strike 2 again topped Steam with more than 1.27 million players online, and the most-read page on Wikipedia was Christa Pike, at 643,029 views.
